research_note: Searched twice. Most likely the North American arm of an Italian stone-machinery maker, either Comes Italy (comesitaly.it, Tito, Potenza) or CO.ME.S Costruzioni Meccaniche Signorini (come.it, Calcinaia), both of which build marble and granite processing machinery. Machinery is an explicit S7.4 exclusion, so the row is out whichever it is and the domain does not matter
40 years old, sells itself on precision machining and quality control from its Jincheon plant. An industrial component maker exhibiting in a surfaces hall. No pattern, no design step

Searched twice, no match. Do NOT use echelontileandstone.com: that is Echelon Tile and Stone, a different Tri-State fabricator and installer, and fabricator-installer fails gate 3 anyway. Echelon Masonry is an Oldcastle brand, also a different company. Needs the TISE exhibitor listing

Germany's leading Jura limestone and dolomite producer: four quarries, ~350,000 tons of raw block a year, ~2 million tonnes of product, 500+ employees. A quarry operator selling wall cladding and floor slabs. Raw stone, no pattern
American-made concrete unit pavers since 1971. Hardscape construction material specified by landscape architects. No customer-facing design step for the tool to sit on

Not a product company at all. i4F licenses a portfolio of 2,000+ patents, mainly floor locking systems, to 100+ flooring manufacturers. There is no product, no pattern and no end customer. Nothing to plug a design tool into

Quarries white and semi-white marble from eleven quarries on the island of Brac and processes it at two plants. Extraction, processing, sale and installation of building stone. Quarry plus installer, two gate-3 problems
Founded 1967, makes polystyrene moulding, frame and panel under the MIGA brand, ~100 patents, exports to 60 countries. Moulding and frame, not a flat patterned surface. Wrong medium

Spun out of LG Chem's decopaper division in 1999 and Korea's decopaper market leader since 2004. It does print decorative pattern, on paper, under the Lovenre brand, so it is closer than most TISE rows. But it sells that paper as a raw surface material to furniture and panel makers, who choose the design. The design decision sits with their customer, not with them
Founded 1997, family owned, makes saws, diamond blades and accessories for cutting tile, marble, masonry and concrete. Tools are an explicit S7.4 exclusion

Pebble tile since 2005, about 50 styles of flat, standing, polished and flower pebble mosaic. By its own description it receives its tiles directly from one of the largest manufacturers in China, so it is the importer, not the maker. Gate 3

Unresolvable by name: at least three unrelated US companies trade as The Stone Factory (thestonefactoryco.com, thestonefactory.net in Orange CT, thestonefactorypalmbeach.com), all of them stone importers or fabricators. Needs the TISE listing, and the row fails gate 3 on every candidate

Manufacturer of New England natural thin stone veneer, cut from real fieldstone. A genuine maker, but the medium is stone veneer for siding and walls, with no pattern to design. Worth noting they already run a Stone Visualizer, so the tooling instinct is there, wrong product

Not stone despite the TISE hall: since 1886 this firm makes coco mats, recycled tire tiles and CUSTOM ENTRANCE MATS. A custom logo mat is genuinely a flat 2D custom product with a client approval step, so criterion 1 and 3 arguably hold and this is not an automatic drop. The question is criterion 2: whether the engine renders a coco or rubber mat usefully. Shahwaz's call, same class of question as the parked niches
The largest quarrier and fabricator of domestic travertine in the US, quarries in the Greater Yellowstone area, fabrication in Idaho Falls. Quarry plus fabricator. Raw stone, no pattern
